answers.born_and_place: I was born on 14 March 1879 in Ulm, Germany.

answers.died: I died on 18 April 1955 in Princeton, United States.
answers.age: I died in 1955, at the age of 76.
answers.siblings: I had one sister, Maja Einstein.
answers.spouse: I was married twice: first to Mileva Marić, then to Elsa Einstein.
answers.children: I had 3 children: a daughter, Lieserl, born in 1902, whose fate is unknown, and my sons Hans Albert and Eduard.
answers.grandchildren: I had 1 grandchild on public record: Bernhard Caesar Einstein.
answers.family: My family on public record: my parents Hermann Einstein and Pauline Koch, 1 sibling, 2 marriages, 3 children, 1 grandchild and other relatives such as Lina Einstein (female first cousin) and Elsa Einstein (female first cousin).
answers.education: I went to the Luitpold Gymnasium in Munich and the cantonal school in Aarau, studied at the Federal Polytechnic in Zurich (now ETH Zurich), and earned my doctorate from the University of Zurich in 1905.
answers.occupation: I was a theoretical physicist, philosopher of science, inventor and science writer.
answers.nationality: I was born a German citizen, became Swiss in 1901, and became an American citizen in 1940.
answers.awards: Awards I received: Nobel Prize in Physics (1921), Barnard Medal for Meritorious Service to Science (1920), Gold Medal of the Royal Astronomical Society (1926), Prix Jules Janssen (1931) and Matteucci Medal (1921).
answers.notable_works: I'm best known for special and general relativity, mass-energy equivalence (E = mc2), the photoelectric effect and my work on Brownian motion.
answers.religion: I was born into a Jewish family, but I didn't believe in a personal God. I called myself agnostic.
answers.party: I was a member of the German Democratic Party.
answers.cause_of_death: I died of a ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm.
